title: Senior Recruiter – Talent Acquisition & HR Operations
description:
**Location:** Andheri – Marol, Mumbai  
**Experience:** 5+ Years  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Only  
**Work Mode:** Work from Office  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for a dynamic, hands-on Senior Recruiter with a minimum of 5 years of experience in end-to-end recruitment and a good understanding of HR operations.

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently managing the complete recruitment lifecycle, sourcing quality candidates through multiple recruitment platforms, coordinating with hiring managers and ensuring timely closures.

Apart from recruitment, the role will also involve supporting day-to-day HR operations, employee coordination, documentation and other generalist HR activities.

This is an Individual Contributor role, requiring someone who is equally comfortable managing recruitment assignments and supporting broader HR responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Talent Acquisition & Recruitment**

* Independently manage the complete end-to-end recruitment lifecycle, from understanding hiring requirements to candidate onboarding.
* Handle multiple recruitment mandates across different functions and experience levels.
* Source candidates through Naukri, Indeed, LinkedIn and other relevant recruitment platforms.
* Demonstrate strong expertise in Boolean searches, database mining, headhunting and passive candidate sourcing.
* Screen resumes, conduct preliminary candidate assessments and evaluate suitability against job requirements.
* Coordinate interviews, follow up with candidates and hiring managers, and ensure timely recruitment closures.
* Negotiate compensation, manage candidate expectations and drive offer-to-joining conversions.
* Build and maintain an active candidate pipeline and recruitment database.
* Track recruitment metrics, hiring status, turnaround time and offer-to-joining ratios.

**2. HR Operations & Generalist Responsibilities**

* Support day-to-day HR operations, including employee documentation, joining formalities and onboarding.
* Coordinate employee attendance, leave records and other HR-related activities.
* Maintain employee records, HR trackers and personnel files.
* Handle employee queries and coordinate routine HR-related matters.
* Support exit formalities, full and final settlement coordination and employee separation documentation.
* Assist with payroll inputs, employee data validation and coordination with the payroll team.
* Support HR policies, compliance documentation and other operational HR requirements.
* Undertake additional HR responsibilities as required by the business.

Desired Candidate Profile

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR will be an added advantage.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in end-to-end recruitment.
* Excellent working knowledge of Naukri, Indeed and LinkedIn.
* Strong sourcing, headhunting, Boolean search and candidate assessment skills.
* Proven ability to independently manage multiple hiring mandates and deliver within defined timelines.
* Good understanding of HR operations, employee lifecycle and generalist HR processes.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, negotiation and coordination skills.
* Proactive, organised and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
* Must be hands-on and willing to work as an individual contributor rather than a purely managerial resource.

Mandatory Requirements

* **Immediate joiners only.**
* Candidates must be available to join immediately.
* Must be comfortable working from our office at Andheri – Marol, Mumbai.
* Candidates serving notice periods will be considered only if they can be relieved immediately.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

We are seeking a Junior Talent Acquisition Executive to own end-to-end hiring for our IT and digital roles, including developers, data, designers, video editors and digital marketing profiles. This is a remote, contractual role with a BYOD policy, for a recruiter who can manage multiple open positions at the same time and close them with the right people, with minimal supervision. It is a fast-paced and challenging role, best suited to someone who takes ownership of every position they work on.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Own the complete recruitment lifecycle for IT roles, from understanding the requirement to the candidate’s joining.

* Work with hiring managers to understand each open position, the skills it needs and the expected closing timeline.

* Experience hiring for a digital agency or IT services company.

* Hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude or Perplexity for sourcing, screening questions, job posts and reporting.

The incumbent will be responsible for controlling the project costs; This includes planning, developing, controlling, and forecasting the project’s budget and schedule. He / She will aim to minimize the deviation from the budget/ Schedule and ensure that the project is completed within the approved budget and timeline.

  

**6.** **Primary Job Functions**
================================

§ Familiarization with the process of project control procedures

§ Understanding Contract vis-à-vis project scope of work

§ Developing Cost WBS structure and control budget for the project based on the approved estimate.

§ Proactively monitor and communicate budget, actual status, and forecast costs/labor hours for projects monthly.

§ Consolidate performance data to support performance measurement, data analysis, and cost forecasting.

§ Assist in the development of project work plans and schedules.

§ Create client and internal status reports that effectively communicate schedule status and identify critical path.

§ Provide technical guidance to other project controls staff in project financial status

§ Ensuring all financials are in order, preparing spreadsheets and a wide variety of routine cost analyses, cash flow, and other cost related evaluations.

§ Set-up, monitor & report earned value progress measurement systems for projects, including analysis based on input from project leads

§ Identify business acumen by identifying for us potential project problems early, report issues and problems to operations leadership, and work with project teams to address and implement recovery plans.

§ Review of expenditure details, identifying incorrect charges, and commencement of the charge correction process will ensure our financials are accurate. To review, process, and track sub consultant invoices on various projects.

§ Prepare and update project schedules and cost/resource loading them.

§ Identify and drive optimizations in planning and execution of projects

§ Advise Project Controls Lead and Project Leadership Team of any potential schedule issues and when necessary, provide guidance on corrective action and measures to mitigate any adverse trends.

§ Develop and review schedule corrective actions and recovery plans and verify needed actions plans are implemented.

§ Review project changes to evaluate detail schedule impact; responsible for quantifying and incorporating the effect and impact of approved changes in the overall schedule stewardship and reporting.

§ Monitor and report on schedule implications of changes

§ Support project team with ongoing project progress measurement and schedule analysis, reporting, and forecasting activities.

§ Develop change management and maintaining change log.

§ Support in monitoring of cost developments of engineering/vendors/contractors and develop the cost reports.

§ Look for ways to reduce project costs and for ways to improve our work processes.

§ Perform price estimation and price budgeting from contract commitment to fit the baseline program

§ Provide planning / scheduling, and cost controlling mechanism for all projects which includes variation reporting, monitoring of milestone progress to the preparation of customer billing processes, etc.

§ Ensure effective project implementation and utilize productive reports from the creation of WBS with the use of project management system to monitor the status of the project.

§ Perform project costing related reporting to the team and management’s review monthly to ensure that expenditures are kept within the project budget.

§ Performing and/or managing the analysis of cost and risks for projects with a focus on support of project management.

§ Accountable for investment of project cost, and schedule and reports to the Project Manager of one or more projects during the planning and execution phase.

Here's what you'll need

  

§ Graduate / Advanced degree in Engineering or other technical disciplines

§ Experience in the infrastructure sector or in construction industry is highly preferable, with exposure in site engineering, project management, project planning, project costing, project scheduling, coordination, procurement and construction workflows.

§ Knowledge in cost control tools and technics to drive /contribute project financial health, knowledge in Estimation, Project / Cost Controlling, Project Tracking, Project Scheduling

§ Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of interdependency of underlying cost and schedule drivers.

§ Demonstrate excellent understanding of the entire system of the business, relationship between productivity vs profitability

§ Good team player with excellent communication and interpersonal skills

§ Ability to communicate effectively (written and verbal) with project stakeholders and proficient to work in any project environment.

§ Ability to prioritize and organize assigned tasks in a timely manner.

§ Ability to follow company procedures and work independently without guidance

§ Proactive and analytic, becoming an integrated part of the team, despite remote engagement

The incumbent will have relationships with one or more of the following:

§ Project Managers, Senior Project Managers, Manager of Projects

§ Project Controllers, Planning Leads, Project Accountants, Commercial Analysts, Procurement

§ Mastery in MS Excel and strong skillset in other MS Office software (Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Outlook)

§ Proficiency in any other cost control tool

§ Knowledge in Planning software like MSP / Primavera, Power BI / Data Visualization software will provide an advantage

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.

  
  

Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.

  
  

At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Our team is recruiting! What are we looking for?

The Workforce Strategy & Operations team manages the end-to-end workforce life cycle, globally, for services engagements. Capacity Planning is a dedicated function within the team. It is responsible for demand and supply forecasting, bench visibility and data-driven decision support for hiring and staffing strategy.

The Capacity Analyst is a hands-on data and modelling role. It supports capacity forecasting for our Global Delivery Center & APAC businesses.
  
This is not a role for reporting what the system already shows. We need someone who can take raw, messy data, clean it, model it and forecast beyond what is available in the system. They add their own analysis and intelligence, and turn the result into clear visuals that leaders can act on.

Key areas of responsibility include: Data Preparation & Integrity, Forecasting & Modelling, Visualization & Insight, Scope & Collaboration.
  
  
We are looking for someone with 3+ years of experience in capacity planning, workforce planning, data analytics or a similar analytical role. You should have proven data mining, statistical modelling and visualisation skills.

You should Up-skill on AI Fluency and AI-native delivery, using AI tools and developer assistants (e.g. Agentforce Vibes, Cursor, Claude).
  
  
**Data Preparation & Integrity**  
  

* Source, mine and combine data from multiple systems and offline sources, going beyond what is available in the system of record
* Clean, validate and reconcile large, messy datasets into a trusted, decision-ready source
* Correct known data issues (e.g. unrealistic demand swings) before they reach stakeholders
* Document data logic, assumptions and definitions so outputs are repeatable and auditable

  
**Forecasting & Modeling**  
  

* Build and maintain demand and supply forecasts across a rolling horizon of two high-likelihood quarters plus a third best-case quarter. This gives leadership enough runway for hiring decisions
* Develop statistical and predictive models, including scenario and sensitivity analysis, rather than only relying on system-reported numbers
* Model demand and supply at the role and cloud-practice level, so business leaders can self-serve more granular slices of the data
* Flag growth areas where in-house hiring or cross-skilling is the right call, rather than defaulting to subcontractor backfill
* Track forecast accuracy against actuals and continuously refine the models

  
**Visualization & Insight**  
  

* Own and evolve self-service dashboards (e.g. in Tableau)
* Maintain the supply & demand dashboard tracking demand change by role and skill
* Turn analysis into clear, visual data stories that show supply, demand and skills-profile challenges for leadership
* Add intelligence on top of the data: highlight drivers, risks and recommended actions, not just number

  
**Minimum Requirements**  
  

* Strong analytics background with proven data mining, statistical and data modelling skills
* Hands-on experience building forecasting models, not only consuming system reports
* Hands-on experience with Tableau or a similar BI tool, including building dashboards end to end
* Ability to interpret large, messy datasets and deliver clean, trustworthy data
* Ability to present analysis visually and clearly

  
  
  
**Must-Have Skills**  
  

* Capacity planning and forecasting modeling
* Data mining, cleansing and analytics
* Tableau (or equivalent BI tool such as Power BI)
* Dashboard design and maintenance
* Advanced Excel / Google Sheets
* SQL and/or Python (or R) for data prep and modeling
* AI-assisted analysis (e.g. Claude, Agentforce, ChatGPT, Gemini) for faster analysis, modeling and insight generation

You will combine deep technical capability with team leadership, driving solution architecture, detailed design and development while ensuring programmes, projects, enhancements and production services are delivered predictably and operate reliably. * Proven experience designing and delivering Project Planning and Workforce Planning solutions that support complex enterprise planning, forecasting and reporting processes.

* Strong experience with Oracle Narrative Reporting and the integration of planning outputs into management and statutory reporting processes.

* A leader who remains technically hands-on and can guide a multidisciplinary engineering team across design, development, testing, deployment, continuous improvement and stable operations.

* Experience operating within the architecture, security, change, risk, governance and control frameworks of a large enterprise, ideally in financial services or another regulated environment.

* A strong collaborator who can translate complex finance, workforce and project planning requirements into robust, supportable engineering solutions.

**Major Responsibilities / Accountabilities**

* Lead the Oracle EPM Planning engineering capability, with end-to-end accountability for solution design, development, delivery and operations.

* Own the technical direction, engineering standards and roadmap for Oracle EPM Cloud Planning, ensuring alignment with finance transformation priorities, enterprise architecture and platform strategy.

* Remain hands-on in application and solution design, including dimensions, metadata, forms, dashboards, business rules, calculation scripts, Groovy rules, approvals, security, data maps, Smart Push, reporting and automation.

* Lead the design and development of Project Planning and Workforce Planning capabilities, including driver-based models, project cost and resource forecasting, workforce demand, headcount, compensation and scenario planning.

* Oversee the design and delivery of Narrative Reporting solutions that connect planning outcomes with management commentary, report packs and controlled reporting processes.

* Lead programmes, projects and enhancements from discovery and requirements through architecture, design, build, testing, deployment, transition and benefits realisation.

* Plan team capacity, prioritise the engineering backlog, manage dependencies and ensure predictable delivery against agreed scope, timelines, quality and control requirements.

* Establish and maintain stable operations, including service monitoring, incident and problem management, release management, planning-cycle readiness, month-end and year-end support, disaster recovery, capacity management and vendor support.

* Partner with Finance, FP&A, HR, Project Finance and process owners to translate business requirements into scalable planning models, calculations, workflows and reporting solutions.

* Design and oversee reliable data integrations between Oracle EPM Cloud and ERP, HR, project accounting, data platforms and upstream or downstream reporting systems, with appropriate reconciliation, lineage, scheduling, monitoring and exception handling.

* Implement effective controls over data, calculations, interfaces, access, change and production operations, with clear evidence to support audit and compliance requirements.

* Ensure solutions comply with enterprise engineering governance, including architecture review, secure engineering standards, SDLC controls, testing, segregation of duties, change management and operational acceptance.

* Identify and deliver appropriate native Oracle EPM AI capabilities and non-native AI use cases across planning, forecasting, workforce, project planning and narrative reporting processes, aligned with enterprise architecture, data, security, model risk and responsible AI controls.

* Lead supplier and implementation partner engagement, including delivery oversight, quality assurance, knowledge transfer and adherence to contractual outcomes.

* Develop team capability through coaching, technical leadership, reusable patterns, documentation, engineering standards and succession planning.

* Drive continuous improvement through automation, performance optimisation, release adoption, simplification, technical debt reduction and improved observability.

**Key Relationships**

The role will partner closely with Group Finance, FP&A, HR and Workforce Planning, Project Finance, Finance Transformation, Enterprise Functions process owners, Enterprise Architecture, Data and Integration Engineering, Cyber Security, Risk and Controls, Service Management, Change and Release Management, and external vendors or implementation partners. The role will also work across the wider Oracle EPM and Finance Engineering landscape to ensure consistent architecture, data, control and operational standards.

**Technical / Professional Skills & Competencies**

**Essential Skills**

* Typically 10+ years of experience delivering or supporting Oracle EPM, enterprise planning, budgeting, forecasting or performance management solutions, including relevant engineering leadership experience.

* Deep hands-on experience with Oracle EPM Cloud Planning, including application design, dimensions, metadata, forms, dashboards, business rules, approvals, security, reporting, automation and performance optimisation.

* Strong hands-on development experience using Groovy within Oracle EPM Cloud to create dynamic rules, validations, calculations, integrations and process automation.

* Proven experience designing and delivering Project Planning solutions, including project costs, resources, revenue, capital expenditure, funding, scenario modelling and integration with ERP or project accounting systems.

* Proven experience designing and delivering Workforce Planning solutions, including headcount, compensation, workforce movements, demand and capacity planning, scenario analysis and integration with HR or payroll platforms.

* Strong experience with Oracle Narrative Reporting, report packages, disclosure or management reporting, commentary workflows and integration with Oracle EPM Cloud data.

* Strong understanding of planning, budgeting, forecasting, scenario modelling, management reporting and associated finance processes.

* Experience leading teams delivering concurrent programmes, projects, enhancements and production operations.

* Strong understanding of the full engineering lifecycle, including requirements, architecture, solution design, development, configuration management, testing, deployment, release, support and continuous improvement.

* Experience designing and operating integrations between Oracle EPM Cloud and ERP platforms such as Oracle ERP Cloud or SAP, together with HR, project, enterprise data and upstream or downstream reporting systems.

* Practical experience with Oracle EPM Data Integration, Data Management, REST APIs, EPM Automate, integration agents, file-based interfaces and enterprise integration tooling.

* Strong data analysis and reconciliation capability, with practical knowledge of SQL, data transformation, control totals, lineage, traceability and issue investigation.

* Demonstrable experience of enterprise governance and controls, including architecture governance, secure engineering, access management, segregation of duties, change management, IT general controls, audit evidence, resilience and disaster recovery.

* Strong service management and operational leadership skills, including incident, problem, change, release, capacity, availability and vendor management.

* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain planning models and technical decisions to finance, engineering, risk and senior leadership audiences.

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, Engineering or a related discipline.

**Desired Skills**

* Experience deploying native Oracle EPM Cloud AI capabilities and integrating non-native AI solutions to improve forecasting, scenario modelling, anomaly detection, data quality, commentary generation, reporting and operational processes, with appropriate governance, security, explainability and human oversight.

* Oracle EPM Cloud Planning, Narrative Reporting, Data Integration or related Oracle certification.

* Experience with Oracle EPM Cloud Financial Consolidation and Close (FCC), including an understanding of how planning, forecasting and consolidation processes integrate across the finance landscape.

* Knowledge of Workday Adaptive Planning, including its planning, forecasting, workforce planning, reporting and integration capabilities, and an understanding of how it compares or coexists with Oracle EPM Cloud Planning.

* Experience with Account Reconciliation, Enterprise Data Management or other Oracle EPM Cloud products.

* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, enterprise data platforms, APIs, integration tooling and DevOps practices.

* Experience with Microsoft Power BI or equivalent reporting and visualisation platforms.

* Experience leading solutions in global financial services or a complex multinational and regulated organisation.

* Create an inclusive, collaborative and high-performing team environment focused on delivery quality, operational excellence and continuous learning.

* Own issues through to resolution, communicate risks transparently and escalate early when delivery, control or operational outcomes are at risk.

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. As a Global Procurement team, our goal is to greatly enhance Nielsen’s long-term profitability and support sustainable growth while managing global risks effectively. We need a skilled analyst to help our teams navigate these changes. The Procurement Analyst will develop and execute sourcing plans for indirect spend related to software (SaaS, Cloud, AI) while maintaining strategic supplier relationships and end to end ownership of key contracts.

In this role, you will be responsible for leading the assessment, selection, negotiation, and execution of global contracts and relationship management of providers of externally contracted services to Nielsen.

Responsibilities

Our Infrastructure Services teams support business-critical ERP and enterprise application environments for customers, helping ensure their systems remain stable, secure and high performing.

* Working directly with customers on technical issues, maintenance and projects
* Collaborating across Consulting, Professional Services, Support and Development teams
* Sharing technical knowledge and mentoring colleagues
* At more senior levels, taking ownership of complex customer environments, leading technical activities and acting as a technical authority

Our opportunities span **Linux Administrator, Infrastructure Services Consultant, Senior Consultant and Principal Consultant-level profiles**.

You might be a hands-on Linux Administrator looking to develop further into infrastructure services and consulting. Alternatively, you may already be an experienced customer-facing infrastructure professional or Principal Consultant who takes ownership of complex technical environments.

As the Manager of Emerging Talent for the AI Builder Program, you will lead, mentor, and scale a high-caliber team of AI-native graduates, and bring a completely fresh approach to problem-solving.This is not a traditional engineering management role; it is a frontier-pushing leadership position designed to channel that native AI mindset into boundary-breaking, real-world customer transformations. **Key Responsibilities**

### **1. People Leadership & Talent Development (40%)**

* **Channel AI-Native Superpowers:** Champion and harness the unique, fast-paced 'group chat' collaboration styles and intuitive AI habits of recent graduates, turning their fresh perspectives into a competitive advantage for our delivery teams.

title: Compliance Manager/Senior Compliance Manager
description:
**Description**

**Who is USP?**

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

**Brief Job Overview**

The Compliance Manager/Senior Compliance Manager is responsible for leading an effective, best practices compliance and ethics culture at USP. The incumbent will ensure compliance with local and global laws, regulations, and organization policies with a focus on matters relating to anti-fraud and conflicts of interest, anti-corruption/anti-bribery, third-party risk management and fostering a strong Speak Up Culture. This global role requires implementation of a program strategy that incorporates the coordination of compliance elements that span across several USP functions and regions and requires seasoned judgment, diplomacy, and an ability to analyze and solve complex problems and to act as a thought partner and collaborator with business leadership and other internal partners including those in Enterprise Risk Management, Internal Audit/Controls, Legal, Global People & Culture (GPC), Employee Relations (ER), and Information Technology Services.

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.

**The Compliance Manager/Senior Compliance Manager has the following responsibilities:**

**Global Compliance & Ethics**

* Partners with the Sr. Director, Global Compliance to coordinate and lead a global compliance and ethics program that is consistent with USP’s mission, vision and values.
* Works alongside leadership in ensuring that USP adheres to best practices and to the U.S. and international laws and regulations that apply to it, including anti-fraud and conflict of interest standards, anti-bribery and anti-corruption laws (e.g., FCPA) and privacy regulations, in order to implement improvements to the compliance framework and programs that strengthen stewardship of USP’s resources.
* Owns the review, guidance and investigation, as necessary, of due diligence requirements within USP’s third party risk management framework.
* Proactively leads efforts to drive USP’s India Speak Up Culture Strategy, including fostering strong, collaborative relationships with India People & Culture, ER, Equity Office and Legal. This also includes administration of USP’s Ethics Liaison Program.
* Periodically reviews and coordinates the policies in USP’s Code of Ethics and ensures that appropriate compliance policies and procedures are adopted, published and explained to employees and other relevant stakeholders.
* Acts as an advocate and champion of the compliance and ethics program among managers and staff through training, day-to-day advice, and guidance on compliance and ethics matters.
* Ensures the India Compliance training plan is executed in a timely manner, with 100% completion by all employees.
* Coordinates with other domestic and international departments and business units to conduct compliance and ethics risk assessments, develop priorities for the global compliance and ethics program, and take actions necessary to resolve potential compliance issues.
* Actively supports the governance dimension of compliance program; prepares governance reports for senior leaders, as needed.
* Ensures there is a system of auditing and monitoring the compliance program’s effectiveness and USP’s compliance with legal and ethical standards. Ensures that all findings of weaknesses in the compliance and ethics program are responded to, or escalated to management, promptly and effectively.
* Gathers, reviews, and analyzes information to identify compliance related trends, patterns, and risk indicators and advise on appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Works effectively with other USP teams (Legal, GPC/ER, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Purchasing, etc.) to identify current and prospective ethics and compliance risks and help to enhance procedures to enable USP to effectively manage those risks.
* Regularly communicates compliance monitoring results to business process owners and senior management.
* Provides support for day-to-day compliance or ethics related questions and issues.
* Assists USP’s leaders to continue to embed a culture of compliance and ethics including training on and reinforcing employee and business partner awareness regarding the risks associated with illegal, unethical, or improper conduct.

**USP India Compliance & Ethics:**

* Actively supports the India Compliance Team.
* Provides day to day support on Ethics and other regulatory and local compliance business process carried out by the India Compliance team.
* Regularly communicate compliance and regulatory updates with the India Site leadership team.
* Own other local regulatory and compliance matters referred or identified by the India Site leadership team.

**Who is USP Looking For?**

The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the below competencies and experience

* Bachelor’s degree required
* Eight (8) years progressive compliance experience,
* Certified Compliance and Ethics Professional (CCEP or CCEP-International) certification)
* Three (3) years compliance experience at an international or multinational business organization
* Demonstrated expertise in the following areas: Anti-Corruption, Anti-Bribery, Anti-Money Laundering regulations; government enforcement actions; voluntary/mandatory disclosures; supply chain compliance; managing conflicts of interest and due diligence.

**Additional Desired Preferences**

Desired preferences include highlighting any additional preferred levels of expertise for the role—reminder: items listed here are not requirements and do not disqualify a candidate from consideration.

* A law degree from a reputed law school preferred
* Knowledge of relevant laws and regulations and experience advising organizations on compliance and regulatory matters, along with expertise in setting up and managing best practices compliance and ethics programs.
* Demonstrated leadership in working within an organization to implement and maintain a comprehensive program designed to ensure compliance and ethics.
* Ability to solve complex problems and to communicate complex issues clearly and concisely, with excellent verbal and written communication skills. Includes an understanding of business goals and objectives and sound practical judgment in developing compliance solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to build strong, credible working relationships cross-functionally, including well-developed interpersonal skills and ability to gain support of and positively influence others’ behavior.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate and interface with regulators and other third parties, and diverse audiences at all levels of the organization.
* Demonstrated solid independent thinking and decision-making ability along with ability to discern and understand multiple and competing viewpoints.
* Intellectual flexibility – adept at reassessing priorities to ensure that internal and external expectations are fulfilled.
* Strong ability to navigate through barriers to drive successful initiatives throughout the business.
* Maturity and decisiveness, including the ability to frame issues to support quick decision making as well as an understanding of business in order to know how and when to escalate issues.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

None, this is an individual contributor role.

**Benefits**

USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.

**Compensation**

**Only listed for USA job opportunities**

Base Salary Range: USD $[XX,XXX – XX,XXXX] annually.

Target Annual Bonus: % Varies based on level of role.

Individual compensation packages are based on various factors unique to each candidate’s skill set, experience, qualifications, equity, and other job-related reasons.

**Third-Party Recruiters:** USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.

**Note:** As part of the recruitment process, USP's Global Talent Acquisition team may contact candidates through a variety of communication channels, including Microsoft Teams, telephone, email, and WhatsApp (voice calls and text messages). These communications may be used to schedule interviews, provide updates on application status, discuss career opportunities, and answer questions about employment with USP.

To help ensure timely communication, candidates are encouraged to keep their contact information current and to engage only with individuals who clearly identify themselves as authorized USP representatives. USP will never request payment, banking details, or other financial information as part of the hiring process.

**Fraud Alert:** USP is committed to protecting job seekers from recruitment fraud. Legitimate employment-related communications will come only from authorized USP representatives. If you are unsure whether a communication is authentic, please verify it through USP’s official careers website before sharing personal information.

title: UN Women National Consultant – PMU (GRB-MWCD), New Delhi, India
description:
**Background:**

UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women, men and diverse genders as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security.

All human development and human rights issues involve gender dimensions. UN Women globally focuses on key priority areas that are fundamental to women’s equality, and that can unlock progress across the board. UN Women’s priority areas include increasing women’s leadership and participation in political spaces, ending violence against women, enhancing women’s economic empowerment, engaging in all aspects of women peace and security processes, making gender equality central to national planning and budgeting through Gender Responsive Budgeting (GRB) and advancing gender in intergovernmental processes.

UN Women’s work on Gender Responsive Budgeting (GRB) or Gender Budgeting (GB) involves ensuring that national planning, budgeting, monitoring and evaluation processes incorporate a gender perspective. UN Women’s GRB programmes at the regional and country level have made significant contribution towards this by building political support, developing technical resources and capacities, generating good practices for improving women's access to services and increasing accountability for Gender Equality and Women’s empowerment (GEWE). At the forefront of global, regional and local advocacy for application of GRB, UN Women has built partnerships with diverse government, inter-governmental and non-governmental partners to further efforts and demonstrate GRB’s relevance to sustainable development, aid effectiveness, public sector reform and financing for development.

UN Women’s India Country Office, based in New Delhi is implementing a project with the objective of strengthening institutional mechanisms for GRB resulting in an increase of gender perspective in budgets, improved availability of data, and tracking of progress on gender equality initiatives across ministries and select states/UTs. It will aim to create a conducive policy environment and enhance institutional capacities on gender budgeting at the national and State/UT level. It will identify strategies and operational approaches to strengthen on-going efforts in the area of GRB. Insights generated from this project will enable key stakeholders at the national and state level to accelerate their efforts to ensure that women’s priorities are adequately reflected in national and state budgeting processes, and to make concrete changes for adequate resource allocation towards women’s priorities.

UN Women through this programme will work with national ministries including Ministry of Women and Child Development (MWCD), Ministry of Finance and line ministries to deepen anchoring of GB across union ministries and sectors. It will create and strengthen institutional mechanisms for GRB and institute methodological changes in Planning-Budgeting and Auditing (PBA) systems for enabling gender responsive actions. The project will aim to enhance capacities of government officials and other stakeholders to implement the gender responsive PBA measures, and leverage technology to advance gender budgeting including through and e-governance tool.

Within this context, UN Women seeks the services of Consultant – PMU (GRB-MWCD) to be embedded in Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India in New Delhi. The Consultant will provide specialised technical and programmatic support to strengthen the implementation and institutionalization of Gender Responsive Budgeting (GRB) across Union Ministries and selected States/UTs.

Reporting to the Program Analyst, GRB, UN Women India Country Office, and working closely with the designated nodal officials in MWCD, the Consultant – PMU (GRB-MWCD) will support the Ministry in strengthening coordination mechanisms, monitoring progress on gender budgeting initiatives, and advancing institutional systems for integrating gender perspectives in planning, budgeting, and monitoring processes across government institutions. The consultant will support in monitoring frameworks, evidence generation, capacity building, and policy inputs related to gender budgeting.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

Under the overall guidance and supervision of Coordinator- GRB, and reporting to the Programme Analyst – GRB, the National Consultant – PMU (GRB-MWCD) will support MWCD in strengthening institutional mechanisms and monitoring frameworks for Gender Responsive Budgeting.

The National Consultant – PMU (GRB-MWCD) will work closely with the nodal official in MWCD, and have the following deliverables:

Strengthening coordination with relevant Ministries on GB-

* Technical assistance to MWCD on expansion of GB to central ministries/ departments and states/UTs
* Providing inputs to various Ministries/Departments on gender issues, particularly for new policies, programmes and legislations.
* Undertaking assessment of Ministries/Departments and States on their progress on GRB and supporting in the development of the Ministry wise and State wise Action Plans on GRB.
* Administer self-assessment tool on GB and support ministries/ departments to undertake and update tool periodically.
* Analysis of document s/references from different Ministries/ States from a gender perspective
* Collate, compile and analyze information and data received from Ministries/gender Budgeting Cells on Gender Budgeting
* Analysis of the Gender Budget Statement, pre and post gender budget analysis of sectors and coordination with Ministries/ Departments with regards to the same.
* Support in conducting a national pre-budget consultation with MWCD, MoF and women’s group and civil society to enable participation and inclusion of women in budget-making processes

Monitoring and Strengthening Gender Budgeting Mechanisms

* Support MWCD in developing and operationalizing monitoring mechanisms for tracking progress of Gender Budgeting initiatives across ministries.
* Undertake assessments of Ministries/Departments and States/UTs to review progress on GRB implementation and identify areas for improvement.
* Support the development and updating of Ministry-wise action plans on Gender Budgeting.
* Facilitate the administration and periodic updating of the Gender Budgeting Self-Assessment Tool for ministries and departments.
* Track and analyze information and data received from Ministries and Gender Budgeting Cells to monitor implementation progress.

Research, Documentation and Dissemination of relevant GRB Resources

* Contributes substantively to the analysis and research of the political, social and economic situation in the country on gender responsive governance/ GRB and prepare substantive inputs
* Document and disseminate resources for GRB, such as case studies and best practices;
* Assist in preparation of documents pertaining to GRB, including Annual Reports, Annual Plans and Results Framework Documents etc;
* Process papers/proposal received for GRB;
* Assist in preparation of Sanction Orders and Bills and monitor progress of unutilized receipts and disbursements, utilization certificates, vouchers, etc. related to assignments pertaining to Gender Budgeting Scheme;
* Assist in preparatory work for review meetings with Secretary and Ministers, including, preparation of resource materials, agenda papers, minutes etc;
* Support IT specialist in roll out and implementation of e governance tool on gender budgeting

Facilitating Training and Capacity Development of various stakeholders on GRB

* Conduct trainings and orientation programmes on Gender Budgeting for (i) Union Government, (ii) State Governments, (iii) District level officers, (iv) PRI members, (v) Training Institutes and (vi) NGO and others;
* Collaborate with training institutions/organizations engaged in training activities with a view to furthering the aims and objectives of Gender Budgeting and providing technical inputs on Gender Budgeting;

Developing Training and IEC Material on GRB

* Developing training tools, manual, and other IEC materials on GRB, as required;
* Provide technical assistance to MWCD in developing guidelines on deepening gender budgeting at panchayat/ urban ward levels
* Provide technical assistance to MWCD in developing guidelines on Gender Auditing and taking gender audit forward.

Any other duties assigned by Supervisor in MWCD and UN Women

**Evaluation Criteria of submissions**

Criteria for shortlisting of CVs will be based on the following assessment:

* Required Degree and Qualification (5 points).
* Minimum Experience relevant to the assignment (10 points).
* Working knowledge and experience of working with National/State Government (5 points).

The evaluation process for selection of the candidate will be based on the following assessment:

* Interview (60%)
* Written Test (40%)

**Deliverables:**

* Substantive positioning of gender budgeting in government policies and strategy
* Effective implementation of gender budgeting in 10 union Ministries and select States in coordination with MWCD
* Strengthened Institutional Mechanisms for Gender Budgeting
* A monitoring framework developed or strengthened to track progress of Gender Budgeting initiatives across ministries and states.
* Analytical inputs provided on Gender Budget Statements and sectoral allocations, including pre-budget and post-budget gender analysis.
* Capacity Building of Government Stakeholders.

**Competencies :**

**Core Values:**

* Integrity;
* Professionalism;
* Respect for Diversity.

**Core Competencies:**

* Awareness and Sensitivity Regarding Gender Issues;
* Accountability;
* Creative Problem Solving;
* Effective Communication;
* Inclusive Collaboration;
* Stakeholder Engagement;
* Leading by Example.

Please visit this link for more information on UN Women’s Values and Competencies Framework:

**Functional Competencies:**

* Consistently approaches work with energy and a positive, constructive attitude
* Demonstrates good oral and written communication skills
* Focuses on impact and result for the partners and responds positively to feedback.
* Sound understanding of development issues and gender
* Adheres to deadlines and follows up on time-bound issues
* Maintains diplomacy, tact and strict confidentiality with internal and external partners and clients.

**Education**

* Master’s Degree or equivalent in Social Sciences/Economics/Social Work /Gender Studies/Public Administration/Policy or related fields.

**Experience**

* Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience at the national/state level working with development projects preferably on Gender Responsive Governance, Gender Equality and Women Empowerment; with hands-on experience of design, implementation and monitoring/evaluation of projects.
* Some experience of working with national/ state governments on gender issues, preferable on gender responsive budgeting.
* Experience of undertaking budgetary/ policy analysis and capacity building of government officials.
* Proficiency in the use of computers and office software packages (MS Word, Excel, etc.).

Any travel, if required will be with prior approval of UN Women as per its travel policy, rules and procedures.

**Language**

Proficiency in English; good command over Hindi in reading and writing

**Statements :**

In July 2010, the United Nations General Assembly created UN Women, the United Nations Entity for Gender Equality and the Empowerment of Women. The creation of UN Women came about as part of the UN reform agenda, bringing together resources and mandates for greater impact. It merges and builds on the important work of four previously distinct parts of the UN system (DAW, OSAGI, INSTRAW and UNIFEM), which focused exclusively on gender equality and women's empowerment.

At UN Women, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment of mutual respect. UN Women recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, ability, national origin, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, competence, integrity and organizational need.

title: HR Executive
description:
**Job Title:** HR & Administration Executive / Officer

**Department:** Human Resources & Administration

**Location:** Plant / Manufacturing Unit

**Reports To:** Plant Head / Operations Head

1. Job Purpose

To manage end-to-end plant human resource operations, statutory labour compliance, time-office/attendance administration, recruitment of shop-floor and staff personnel, and general facility administration to ensure uninterrupted manufacturing operations and a disciplined work environment.

2. Key Responsibilities A. Time-Office, Attendance & Payroll Administration

* Maintain daily biometric attendance records, shift rosters, overtime (OT) logs, and leave balances for both on-roll staff and contract manpower.
* Process monthly attendance cut-off data accurately and coordinate with Finance/Accounts for timely salary and contractor billing disbursement.
* Enforce shift punctuality, gate-pass protocols, and leave approval workflows across production, quality, and maintenance departments.

B. Statutory & Labour Compliance

* Ensure 100% compliance with applicable labour laws, including the **Factories Act, EPF, ESIC, Payment of Wages Act, Minimum Wages Act, Payment of Bonus Act, Contract Labour (R&A) Act, and Labour Welfare Fund (LWF)**.
* Maintain statutory registers, muster rolls, accident registers, and display mandatory statutory notices on plant notice boards.
* Coordinate timely monthly challan filings and handle inspections/audits by Factory Inspectors, PF/ESIC authorities, and ISO/GMP/customer auditors.

C. Recruitment & Onboarding

* Manage end-to-end hiring for shop-floor operators, technicians (fitters/electricians), supervisors, and support staff through job portals, local consultants, and ITI/campus tie-ups.
* Conduct induction and onboarding programs covering company policies, shop-floor discipline, cGMP/hygiene standards, and EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) protocols.
* Maintain updated personnel files, KYC documents, medical fitness certificates, and issue appointment letters and ID cards.

D. Industrial Relations & Shop-Floor Discipline

* Act as the primary point of contact for resolving employee grievances and maintaining harmonious industrial relations on the shop floor.
* Administer disciplinary actions (show-cause notices, warning letters, domestic inquiries) in line with company standing orders and HR policy.
* Monitor contract labour deployment and verify vendor statutory compliance (PF/ESIC challans and wage registers) before clearing monthly vendor invoices.

E. Training, Performance & Administration

* Maintain the annual Training Calendar and training effectiveness records (especially mandatory GMP, SOP, and safety trainings).

description:
Compute SpecialistThis role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE partner/customer office.

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

**Global Sales** at HPE is about building the future. We are redefining what’s next and combining our legacy of innovation with a bold new goal to accelerate everything we do. Our sales organization is comprised of 10,000+ professionals in sales, presales, service, and support functions. Together with our partners, we deliver global, commercial, public sector & small/medium business customers throughout 11 geographies. We’re transforming businesses. Join us redefine what’s next for you.

***Job Family Definition:***

Sales Specialists & Consultants are product, services, software or solution specialists that are responsible for leading pursuit in their assigned focus areas. Collaborates with and supports Account Managers and provides specialist expertise within the sales team. Drives proactive campaigns to build the pipeline, uses specialized knowledge and skills to prospect, qualify, negotiate and close opportunities. May have named accounts allocated, cover a designated geography, or may be allocated to one high-potential, competitive attack account.

***Management Level Definition:***

Applies **advanced** subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues and is regarded as a subject matter expert. Frequently contributes to the development of new ideas and methods. Works on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of multiple factors. Leads and/or provides expertise to functional project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives. Acts as an expert providing direction and guidance to process improvements and establishing policies. Frequently represents the organization to external customers/clients. Exercises significant independent judgment within broadly defined policies and practices to determine best method for accomplishing work and achieving objectives. May provide mentoring and guidance to lower level employees.

**What you’ll do:**

***Responsibilities:***

* Responsible for creating, developing, and driving the sales pipeline for HPE Compute solutions, including enterprise servers, HPE ProLiant platforms, and data center infrastructure. Capture leads outside the compute specialization and ensure effective lead assignment and follow-up through closed-loop lead management.
* Maintains in-depth knowledge of competing server and compute infrastructure offerings, including Dell PowerEdge, Lenovo ThinkSystem, and Cisco UCS, to strategically position HPE Compute solutions.
* Leverages compute specialization to identify new business opportunities and expand existing accounts through server refresh, infrastructure modernization, workload migration, virtualization, and data center transformation initiatives.
* Provides compute solution expertise and business development support to Account Managers, contributing to account strategy, opportunity development, and solution positioning.
* Develops quota objectives, sales strategies, and future business direction for the defined Compute product portfolio, driving revenue growth across enterprise server and infrastructure solutions.
* Drives opportunities involving enterprise compute workloads, including SAP, databases, virtualization, cloud infrastructure, and AI/ML workloads.
* Establishes professional, consultative relationships with customers, including CIOs, CTOs, IT infrastructure heads, and data center leaders, by understanding their compute infrastructure requirements and business objectives.
* Works closely with presales architects, solution specialists, and external technology partners to develop and deliver customized compute infrastructure solutions that address customer requirements.
* For Services Consultants: Focuses on growing contractual renewals for mid-to-large accounts involving compute infrastructure support, server lifecycle management, and related infrastructure services, driving higher total contract value.
* Directs and coordinates supporting sales activities, including solution presentations, technical discussions, commercial negotiations, and deal closure, in collaboration with internal sales and technical teams.

**What you need to bring**

***Education and Experience Required:***

* University or Bachelor's degree with directly related previous work experience.
* Demonstrated achievement of progressively higher sales quotas, experience across diverse enterprise customers, and engagement with senior-level stakeholders.
* Extensive enterprise technology sales experience, preferably in server infrastructure, compute solutions, and data center technologies.
* Typically 8–12 years of advanced sales experience, with a proven track record of selling enterprise compute or server infrastructure solutions.
* Strong experience in managing large-value infrastructure sales opportunities, account planning, and complex sales cycles.
* 4+ years of product sales experience in the Compute or Server Infrastructure specialization.
* Project management and opportunity management skills required.

***Knowledge and Skills:***

  

* Expert knowledge of enterprise compute solutions, server infrastructure, and data center technologies, with the ability to position and sell complex compute solutions.
* Strong understanding of enterprise server platforms, including HPE ProLiant, Dell PowerEdge, Lenovo ThinkSystem, or equivalent server solutions.
* Knowledge of server architecture and configurations, including processors (Intel Xeon/AMD EPYC), memory, storage, GPU capabilities, and networking components.
* Understands enterprise workloads and their compute requirements, including SAP HANA, databases, ERP applications, virtualization, cloud infrastructure, and AI/ML workloads.
* Knowledge of virtualization technologies such as VMware vSphere, Microsoft Hyper-V, and associated enterprise infrastructure solutions.
* Understands data center infrastructure, server consolidation, infrastructure refresh, workload migration, and hybrid cloud environments.
* Ability to understand customer IT infrastructure challenges and translate business requirements into scalable, high-performance, and cost-effective compute solutions.
* Deep knowledge of HPE Compute offerings, competitive server platforms, and the ability to articulate HPE's technology differentiation and value proposition.
* Understands the role of IT infrastructure within enterprise organizations and how compute solutions address specific industry and business challenges.
* Applies account planning, sales forecasting, and program/project management methodologies to define, plan, resource, track, and successfully close complex compute opportunities.
* Collaborates with Account Managers, presales architects, solution specialists, and management teams to ensure seamless integration of compute sales activities across shared accounts.
* Cultivates and maintains strong customer relationships to drive account retention, infrastructure expansion, and long-term business growth.
* Demonstrates leadership and initiative in driving compute sales opportunities through prospecting, solution positioning, commercial negotiations, and deal closure.
* Demonstrates strong understanding of server lifecycle management, high availability, business continuity, and enterprise infrastructure modernization.
* Understands how to leverage HPE's broader portfolio across Compute, Storage, Networking, Hybrid Cloud, and Services to develop integrated infrastructure solutions.
* Maintains expertise in emerging compute technologies, industry trends, competitive offerings, and partner/ISV solutions relevant to enterprise data center environments.
* Maintains awareness of evolving enterprise IT requirements, including AI infrastructure, cloud adoption, workload modernization, and data center transformation.

**Accessibility**

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

**What We Can Offer You:**

**Health & Wellbeing**

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

**Personal & Professional Development**

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

**Unconditional Inclusion**

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At NIKE, Inc. it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**
--------------------------

As a Senior Engineering Manager in Partners and Sports Marketing engineering organization, you will be part to design and deliver, best in class commerce experiences for our customers worldwide. We invest and develop advances in technology and employ the most creative people in the world, and then give them the support to constantly innovate, iterate and serve consumers more directly and personally. Our teams are innovative, diverse, multidisciplinary and collaborative, taking technology into the future and bringing the world with it.

  

You will join an extended team of fellow engineers that nurture an engineering culture with its roots in diversity, inclusion and equality. As a team we embrace a DevOps culture and have a can-do mentality. We own the products we build and support. The candidate will have a depth of knowledge and experience in software engineering paradigms. The role will provide the opportunity to identify solutions and solve complex business and technical problems by impacting multiple squads.

  

**WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON**
-------------------------

As a Senior Manager of Software Engineering on our Partners and Sports Marketing Engineering team, you will craft the technical vision, design, build, lead and own global commerce applications. We have broad experience of successfully delivering value and our contributions will help Nike realize efficiencies and build profitable customer experiences. We're looking for someone who is passionate about developing and leading global web-scale applications in the cloud.

  

* Strong technical foundation in UX and backend - able to engage in design reviews, challenge architecture choices, and earn the trust of senior ICs.
* Proven experience leading teams that build and operate production platforms - APIs, pipelines, services at scale.
* Demonstrated ability to set multi-quarter roadmaps, balance KLO/TCO reduction with new investment, and drive aggressive simplification.
* Track record of attracting, hiring, growing, and retaining strong engineering talent across levels (SWE I through Principal).
* Strong operational rigor - SLAs, observability, on-call practices, incident response, capacity and cost management.
* Innovating, architecting, designing, and implementing highly available, scalable systems, focusing on highly visible marketing initiatives
* Own the design and development of a technical solution that meets the needs of the business and aligns with architectural and quality standards
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to your teammates and develop a team environment that promotes collaboration and innovation
* Advocate technical direction, define standard methodologies, inform team principles, and evaluate decisions and their impact on the architecture
* Write clean, maintainable code that is scalable, reliable, and observable to the team’s business deliverables
* Work in full DevOps model leading the entire tech stack including implementing, deploying, monitoring, and operating services at scale
* Ensure software is of the highest quality that meets all deliverables within the constraints of demanding schedules
* Provide technical leadership in design and implementation of GenAI-powered capabilities (RAG, prompt-driven workflows, MCP and spec-driven architectures) to deliver faster, scalable, intelligent capabilities & experiences
* Resolve technical issues and remove blockers for the team
* Encourage innovation by learning new technologies and creating prototypes to share new technical approaches with the team
* Partner with the Product Owners to drive clarity on requirements, define technical options, provide estimates of effort and risk, and evaluate technical feasibility
* Great product sense and communicate effectively both verbally and written in a variety of settings and tailor communications to the target audience
* Influence others through optimism, self-assurance, and fact-based recommendation.
  

**WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH**
--------------------------

  

You will be reporting into the Software Engineering Director, who will guide you to grow and build your career path. As a Senior engineering manager, you will be accountable on engineering delivery of multiple squads, in order to solve a wide range of business and technology related problems.

  

You will work with a team of engineers and architects collaborating with program, business and product owners across the globe to envision and deliver innovative, detailed solutions that enable Nike, Inc.’s experience for our consumers and customers across the world.

  
  

**WHAT YOU BRING**
------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or equivalent.
* 5+ years of technical leadership experience leading a 15+ person full-stack development teams.
* 10 -15 years of technical expertise building services using micro service architecture, domain driven design, and RESTful Services using languages such as Java, Node, Python etc.
* Possess Retail Domain knowledge.
* Experience in owning delivery of the capabilities in your portfolio - APIs, pipelines, services, UX applications, search engines, partnering with product on the roadmap and trade-offs.
* Experience in managing Engineering Managers and/or senior ICs - coaching them, growing their careers, and holding the bar on engineering and leadership excellence
* Experience in owning production reliability, security, and cost across your squads - setting SLAs, leading major incident response, and driving operational maturity.
* Experience in partnering with the platform teams to adopt recommended toolkits and blueprints, and influence the platform roadmap where gaps exist.
* Experience in attracting and hiring exceptional engineers, build an inclusive and high-trust culture, and grow people across levels from SWE I to Principal Engineers.
* Representing the organisation in cross Nike forums, contribute to enterprise architecture and governance decisions, and translate strategy into clear team commitments.
* Experience in leading designing and implementing highly scalable services on cloud and driving strong engineering practices.
* Possess a proven technical background and deep knowledge of software engineering principles, exceptional problem solving, design, programming, and testing skills
* Proven experience designing and developing on the AWS cloud infrastructure is a must. AWS components: CloudFormation, CloudFront, EC2, ECS, RDS, SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, S3, Lambdas and API Gateway.
* Experience in designing and integrating GenAI/LLM-powered capabilities (RAG, prompt engineering, MCP, and spec-driven development) within scalable full‑stack applications
* Strong AI-first mindset, actively leveraging AI powered developer tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code etc) to accelerate development and learning
* Familiarity with security technology and concepts (Authentication, Authorization, Single sign-on, etc.)
* Experience with CI/CD across multiple platforms, such as GitHub action, Jenkins, Slack, Jira.
* Strong experience building and maintaining cross-platform test automation frameworks
* Observability experience building monitoring dashboards in tools like SignalFx, New Relics, and Splunk
* A track record of solving problems and getting things done in a fast-paced, results-oriented, and customer-focused environment
* Excellent verbal and written communication and collaboration skills to effectively connect with both business and technical teams

NIKE, Inc. is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. Nike offers a generous total rewards package, casual work environment, a diverse and inclusive culture, and an electric atmosphere for professional development. Go into this stage confident by doing your research, understanding what we are looking for and being prepared for questions that are set up to learn more about you, and your background.
